v2.1.3.name: MASKLESS LITHO v2.1.3
v2.1.3.body:
## MASKLESS LITHO v2.1.3

A stability release following a detailed review of hardware safety, DLP output, UV Keystone, GDS Import, Motorized Focus, and Align/Draw CAD.

### Key fixes
- Keep the safety fault active and block further exposure if LED OFF, current reset, or fan recovery fails.
- Eliminate race conditions that could execute delayed LED or Sequence callbacks after stopping.
- Validate native 1920x1080 DLP resolution and 100% Windows scaling, and reliably save monitor identity.
- Associate UV Keystone profiles with the lens and DLP device, and block profiles from an incompatible setup.
- Improve GDS layer/datatype selection, actual-pixel frame checks, asynchronous conversion, cancellation, and preview caching.
- Include Focus v0.1.1 in the single executable and prevent simultaneous Focus operation and Maskless exposure.
- Fix double scaling when opening a perspective-corrected Align View in Draw CAD.
- Save settings and Keystone profiles atomically, and restore the previous UI state if saving fails.
- Rewrite the Korean README with v2.1.3 operating instructions and a safety checklist.

### Downloads
- `maskless_v2_1_3.exe`: single executable.
- `maskless_v2_1_3.zip`: ZIP archive of the single executable.
- `maskless_v2_1_3_fast.zip`: portable folder for faster startup.

Python and a separate Focus executable are not required to use GDS or Motorized Focus on another PC. Camera and motor manufacturer drivers may still be required.

### QC / QA
- Full automated suite: 755 passed, 21 subtests passed.
- GDS samples: 4 files, 252 layers, and 252 renders passed.
- compileall, pip check, and git diff check passed.
- Onefile main application and embedded Motorized Focus startup smoke tests passed.
- Fast Portable main application and embedded Motorized Focus startup smoke tests passed.

Actual UV emission, DLP optical output, camera and motor operation, and sample exposure quality must be verified on the PC connected to the equipment.

## MASKLESS LITHO v2.1

This stable release consolidates GDS Import, UV Keystone, Motorized Focus, and manual LED improvements from the v2.0.10 series.

### Main updates
- Stabilize manual LED status: show `Manual LED starting...`, then continuously update the elapsed `Manual exposing...` time.
- Automatically apply UV Keystone correction or use raw output when `LED ON` is pressed, according to the active profile state.
- Check that the main/camera monitor and DLP monitor have matching native resolutions before starting UV Keystone Calibration.
- Support GDS layer/datatype selection, preview zoom, draggable DLP crop frames, and indication of geometry inside the frame.
- Run Motorized Focus as an internal mode of `maskless_v2_1.exe`, without a separate executable.
- Rewrite the README for v2.1.

## v2.0.10.5 UV Keystone Preview/Expose Hotfix

- Separate `LED ON` into a raw manual-output path for checking the hardware and DLP. This version does not apply UV Keystone correction through that path.
- Add `Keystone Preview / Expose` to inspect actual UV output with the active UV Keystone profile.
- Prepare the corrected image before enabling the LED for Keystone Preview/Expose. On failure, warn and stop instead of falling back to a black image.
- Treat DLP image-output failures as hardware errors in Sequence `Start` and `CAD Expose Now`, and stop before setting current or enabling the LED.

- py_compile passed for the main Python files.
- git diff --check passed.
- PyInstaller build passed.

- No PyInstaller missing-module warnings for uv_keystone, uv_keystone_window, or gdstk.

## Usage notes

v2.0.8.8.name: MASKLESS LITHO v2.0.8.8
v2.0.8.8.body:
## MASKLESS LITHO v2.0.8.8

This release includes cumulative changes from v2.0.8.3 through v2.0.8.8, compared with the previous GitHub release, v2.0.8.

## Main changes

### 1. Draw CAD workflow
- Add Draw CAD directly from Align Viewer.
- Replace the separate CAD-window workflow with a dedicated CAD View that copies the Align View state.
- Temporarily hide the original Align View during CAD editing and restore it when CAD View closes.
- Copy position, size, rotation, and perspective correction into CAD View so editing uses the same alignment plane.
- Prevent CAD View and editing controls from appearing on the DLP monitor.

### 2. CAD save, load, and PNG export
- `Save CAD`: save editable `.maskcad` documents.
- `Load CAD`: reopen saved `.maskcad` files for editing.
- `Export PNG`: save a DLP-resolution PNG to a user-selected location.
- `Apply`: send the exported PNG through the existing Pattern Settings image-loading flow.
- `Expose Now`: run one exposure through the existing safe exposure path after confirmation.
- Keep `.maskcad` and PNG files under the same base name.

### 3. KLayout-style drawing controls
- Add or organize `Select`, `Rect`, `Ellipse`, `Line`, `Polyline`, `Polygon`, and `Measure` tools.
- Improve connected-segment drawing for Line, Polyline, and Polygon.
- Hold `Shift` to snap angles to horizontal, vertical, or diagonal directions, including Polygon drawing.
- Show live width/height, length, angle, area, and center-coordinate readouts while drawing.
- Improve the readout layout to avoid clipping in small panels.
- Add `Grid Snap` and `Grid um` controls for DLP/um-based grid snapping.
- Add Undo/Redo, Delete, Esc, and Enter shortcuts.
- Improve selection: click near a line, inside a polygon, or select the topmost overlapping shape.

### 4. Shape editing and arrays
- Add corner and center handles for Rect/Ellipse.
- Add vertex handles for Polyline/Polygon.
- Add Array duplication using `Nx`, `Ny`, `Pitch X`, and `Pitch Y`.
- Keep Measure Tool results out of saved documents and exposed geometry.

### 5. CAD over an existing image
- Add `Include Base Image`.
- Draw additional CAD shapes over a loaded image and export or expose them together, without converting the image to CAD.
- Remove complex image tracing from the default workflow because of quality and stability concerns, using CAD overlays instead.

### 6. Align View display and resizing
- Allow independent horizontal and vertical scaling of the Align View image to fit the window.
- Hold Shift while resizing to preserve the original aspect ratio through uniform scaling.
- Add an Align View Reset button.
- Strengthen coordinate-transform tests for 1-point, 2-point, and 4-point Align Wizard modes and the updated display behavior.

### 7. Legacy DLP compatibility
- Separate Modern and Legacy modes, selectable through `Use Legacy PDC05 DLL` in Settings.
- Use the bundled Legacy DLL without requiring the user to select a DLL file.
- Add `controller/legacy/LibUSB3DPrinter.dll` and the legacy source-build workflow.
- Disable unsupported fan, temperature, and version features in Legacy mode, or show Unknown.
- Interpret Legacy status echo `246` as ready.
- Keep the existing Modern DLL path; activate Legacy only when the toggle is enabled.

### 8. GDS Import Beta
- Add Load GDS Beta for internal testing.
- Select layer/datatype from GDS/GDS2, convert it to a DLP-resolution PNG, and apply it in Pattern Settings.
- Hide GDS beta controls in the standard executable.
- Enable import only in a separate gdsbeta build or with the beta build flag.
- Require a saved CAD scale profile and a configured MASKLESS LITHO Display.
- Safely block geometry outside the DLP region, empty conversion results, and unselected multiple top cells.
- Block GDS import before file selection while a sequence or manual DLP LED output is active.

### 9. Exposure safety and stability
- Fix a short-exposure timing hazard where SequenceRunner could report completion before LED OFF.
- Start the progress timer after LED ON and wait for LED OFF before finishing a step or sequence.
- Use the same SequenceRunner safety path for CAD Expose Now and ordinary sequences.
- Strengthen the path that safely clears manual LED output before controlled exposure.
- Add `_SafeRotatingFileHandler` to keep logging active when Windows locks a file during log rotation.

### 10. UI text and help
- Standardize runtime UI text in English.
- Add tooltips and help text for key buttons, parameters, CAD tools, and settings.
- Use a vertical Draw CAD tool palette with scrolling on smaller screens.
- Retain build naming that can disable Draw CAD in CAD-disabled builds.

## Usage and distribution
- Recommended standard distribution: `maskless_v2_0_8_8.exe`.
- Internal GDS beta testing: `maskless_v2_0_8_8_gdsbeta.exe`.
- GDS beta converts selected layers/datatypes to a DLP PNG for Apply/Expose; it does not import editable CAD geometry.
- Because Align View now supports free scaling, realign it on the equipment after updating, or use Reset Align and align again.

## QA / verification
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: 83 tests OK.
- `py_compile`: 38 Python files OK.
- `git diff --check`: OK.
- Conversion QC passed for `basic.gds`, `gratings_flat.gds`, and `nuts_and_bolts.gds`.
- PyInstaller build passed.
- Standard executable passed a 5-second startup smoke test.
- GDS beta executable passed a 5-second startup smoke test.
- Three subagent reviews covered CAD, Align, DLP safety, and GDS packaging; no build-blocking issues were found.

## Attached files
- `maskless_v2_0_8_8.exe`: standard distribution build.
- `maskless_v2_0_8_8_gdsbeta.exe`: internal GDS beta test build.

## SHA256
- `maskless_v2_0_8_8.exe`: `B4506FEE07BD507932D53BD91C640D848FA1721EB356E3AA5686A4F0EC550352`
- `maskless_v2_0_8_8_gdsbeta.exe`: `1AFCB45E85B7B1AF5C349E53BB1D365AD46B4BABB84D57861B9549D6F3A68E53`
